outcomeClusters.title: Temperature & Thermal Energy
outcomes: Define temperature as a measure of the average kinetic energy of the particles.
Convert the various temperature scales from one scale to another.
Define internal energy and thermal equilibrium.
Explain the changes in the temperature of two objects reaching thermal equilibrium.

outcomeClusters.title: Heat Transfer
outcomes: Explain heat as the energy transferred between substances that are at different temperatures.
Relate heat and temperature change on the macroscopic level to particle motion on the microscopic level.
Explain how heat transfers occur by conduction, convection, and radiation.

outcomeClusters.title: Conservation of Energy (Thermal Context)
outcomes: Apply the principle of energy conservation to calculate changes in potential, kinetic, and internal energy.

outcomeClusters.title: Thermodynamic Laws
outcomes: State the Zeroth law of thermodynamics.

outcomeClusters.title: Specific Heat Capacity
outcomes: Calculate the specific heat capacity of a substance.

outcomeClusters.title: Latent Heat
outcomes: Calculate the latent heat of a substance.

outcomeClusters.title: Heating Curves
outcomes: Interpret the various sections of a heating curve.
